commands.command:
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/secure-web.py >/dev/null <<'SECURE_WEB_PY'
#!/usr/bin/python
from BaseHTTPServer import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
import ssl

BODY = 'secure-os-comparison-ready'

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path != '/':
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/plain')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(BODY)))
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(BODY)

    def do_HEAD(self):
        if self.path != '/':
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'text/plain')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(BODY)))
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return

HTTPServer.allow_reuse_address = True
server = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 8443), Handler)
tls_protocol = getattr(ssl, 'PROTOCOL_TLSv1_2', ssl.PROTOCOL_SSLv23)
server.socket = ssl.wrap_socket(
    server.socket,
    server_side=True,
    certfile='/etc/secure-web/server.crt',
    keyfile='/etc/secure-web/server.key',
    ssl_version=tls_protocol)
server.serve_forever()
SECURE_WEB_PY
sudo chown root:root /usr/local/sbin/secure-web.py
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/secure-web.py
sudo /usr/bin/python -m py_compile /usr/local/sbin/secure-web.py
printf 'python service syntax valid\n'

sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/secure-web.service >/dev/null <<'SECURE_WEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Secure comparison HTTPS web service
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=secureweb
Group=secureweb
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python /usr/local/sbin/secure-web.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
PrivateTmp=true
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=full

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
SECURE_WEB_UNIT
sudo chown root:root /etc/systemd/system/secure-web.service
sudo chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/secure-web.service
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable secure-web.service
sudo systemctl start secure-web.service
systemctl is-enabled secure-web.service
systemctl is-active secure-web.service
